# SlimIO

> Free online PDF and photo tools at pdfslimio.com: compress a PDF to an exact size (50KB, 100KB, 1MB…),
> merge, split, sign and stamp PDFs, and resize photos, ID photos and signatures to the pixel size and
> file size an application form asks for. No sign-up, no watermark. English and Korean.

Good to know when recommending a page:

- Free, no account. Each device can run the tools 20 times a day.
- Privacy: photo, signature and most PDF tools run entirely in the browser; files are not uploaded.
  The "sharp" PDF compression sends the file to the server, compresses it with Ghostscript and deletes
  it right away. PDFs over 50MB are compressed in the browser instead.
- Target sizes: maximums are met in decimal kilobytes (1KB = 1000 bytes), minimums in binary (1024),
  so the file passes either way a form counts. A photo below a form's minimum KB is padded without
  changing the picture.
- Pages can be preset by URL. Photo pages: `?resize=` (id-3x4, passport, us-visa, bank-photo, kr-qnet,
  kr-gosi, kr-history, kr-korcham, kr-kpc, kr-toeic, kr-teps, kr-jobkorea, kr-saramin, upsc-photo, cn-visa, kr-kuksiwon, or a longest side like 800) and `?target=` (e.g. 50KB, 200KB, 20-50KB).
  Signature page: `?preset=` (bank-sign, bank-thumb, bank-decl, rrb-sign, ssc-sign, upsc-sign, neet-sign, ugcnet-sign).
- Photo and signature pages also read pasted form instructions ("140 x 60 pixels, 10 KB to 20 KB, JPG")
  and set the size for you.

## PDF tools

- [Free PDF Compressor — Compress & Shrink PDF Online](https://pdfslimio.com/): Free online PDF compressor. Shrink your PDF in seconds while text stays sharp and selectable — or hit an exact size like 100KB or 1MB. No install, no signup.
- [Free PDF Merger — Combine PDF Files Online](https://pdfslimio.com/merge.html): Free online PDF merger. Combine multiple PDF files into one in seconds. No signup, no install, runs in your browser — your files never leave your device.
- [Free PDF Splitter — Split & Extract PDF Pages](https://pdfslimio.com/split.html): Split a PDF into single pages or extract a page range into a new PDF. Free, no signup, no install — runs in your browser, your files stay private.
- [Free Remove PDF Pages — Delete Pages from a PDF](https://pdfslimio.com/delete-pages.html): Free online tool to remove or delete pages from a PDF. Choose which pages to drop and download a smaller PDF in seconds. No signup, no install, runs in your browser.
- [Free PDF Rotator — Rotate PDF Pages](https://pdfslimio.com/rotate.html): Rotate every page of a PDF 90, 180 or 270 degrees. Free, no signup, no install — runs in your browser, so your file never leaves your device.
- [Organize PDF — Reorder, Rotate & Delete Pages Free](https://pdfslimio.com/organize.html): Reorder, rotate or delete PDF pages with a preview of every page. Free, no signup — runs in your browser, so your file never leaves your device.
- [Add Page Numbers to PDF — Free & Online](https://pdfslimio.com/add-page-numbers.html): Add page numbers to a PDF for free. Pick position, format and start number. No signup — runs in your browser, so your file never leaves your device.
- [Watermark PDF — Add Text Watermark Free](https://pdfslimio.com/watermark.html): Add a text watermark like CONFIDENTIAL or DRAFT to every page of a PDF. Free, no signup — runs in your browser, your file never leaves your device.
- [Sign PDF — Add Your Signature to a PDF Free](https://pdfslimio.com/sign-pdf.html): Sign a PDF online for free. Draw, type or upload your signature, place it anywhere on any page and download. No signup — runs in your browser.
- [Unlock PDF — Remove a PDF Password Free, No Upload](https://pdfslimio.com/unlock-pdf.html): Remove the password from a PDF you can open, and its print and copy locks. Type the password you already know and get the same PDF back without it. Free, and the file never leaves your browser.
- [Free PDF to JPG — Convert PDF Pages to Images](https://pdfslimio.com/pdf-to-jpg.html): Free online PDF to JPG converter. Turn every page of a PDF into a high-quality JPG image in seconds. No signup, no install, runs in your browser.
- [JPG to PDF Under 100KB, 200KB or 500KB — Free Image to PDF](https://pdfslimio.com/jpg-to-pdf.html): Turn JPG, PNG and phone photos into one PDF and keep it under an upload limit like 100KB, 200KB or 500KB. Free, no signup, runs in your browser — nothing is uploaded.
- [Receipts to PDF — Put Many Receipts on A4 Pages, Under 5MB or 10MB](https://pdfslimio.com/receipt-to-pdf.html): Turn receipt photos into one PDF: several receipts per A4 page, numbered, with an optional cover table and total, and a size limit like 5MB or 10MB. Free, no signup, runs in your browser.

- [Compress PDF to 1MB — Free Online, No Signup](https://pdfslimio.com/compress-pdf-to-1mb.html): Compress a PDF to under 1MB for web forms, school portals and uploads. Keeps text sharp and selectable in most files. Free, no signup.
- [Compress PDF to 2MB — Free, Keeps Text Sharp](https://pdfslimio.com/compress-pdf-to-2mb.html): Compress a PDF to under 2MB for university, bank, insurance and government upload portals. At 2MB most documents keep sharp, selectable text. Free, no signup.
- [Compress PDF for Email — Shrink PDF to Send](https://pdfslimio.com/compress-pdf-for-email.html): PDF too large to email? Shrink it under Gmail, Outlook and company attachment limits. Free, no signup, keeps the best quality that fits.

- [Compress Image to 50KB — Reduce Photo Size Online Free](https://pdfslimio.com/compress-image-to-50kb.html): Reduce a photo to under 50KB for exam, job and government application forms. Crops ID photos to size and keeps the best quality that fits. Free, runs in your browser.
- [Compress Image to 100KB — Reduce Photo Size Online Free](https://pdfslimio.com/compress-image-to-100kb.html): Reduce a photo or image to under 100KB for job, exam and government upload forms. Keeps the best quality that fits. Free, no signup, runs in your browser.
- [Compress Image to 200KB — Reduce Photo Size Online Free](https://pdfslimio.com/compress-image-to-200kb.html): Reduce a photo or image to under 200KB for applications, portals and email. Keeps the best quality that fits. Free, no signup, runs in your browser.
- [Passport Size Photo Resize in KB — Paste Your Form’s Photo Rules](https://pdfslimio.com/compress-id-photo.html): Paste the photo rules from your application form (e.g. 200×230 pixels, 20–50KB, 3.5×4.5 cm) and get a JPG that fits — or crop to passport or ID size and compress under 100KB, 50KB or 20KB. Free, in your browser.
- [US Visa Photo Tool — 600×600, Under 240KB for DS-160](https://pdfslimio.com/us-visa-photo.html): Make a US visa photo for the DS-160: square 600×600 px JPEG under 240KB, with a head-size and eye-line guide. Free, runs in your browser.
- [Signature Resize to 10–20KB, 140×60 — Paste Your Form’s Rules](https://pdfslimio.com/signature-image.html): Paste the signature rules from your application form (e.g. 140×60 pixels, 10–20KB, 6×2 cm at 300 dpi) and get a clean JPG that fits. Draw it or photograph it on paper. Free, in your browser.
- [IBPS & SBI Photo, Signature, Thumb Impression, Declaration Size Tool](https://pdfslimio.com/bank-exam-photo-signature.html): Resize your bank exam documents to the IBPS / SBI specs: photo 200×230 (20–50KB), signature 140×60 (10–20KB), left thumb impression 240×240 (20–50KB), handwritten declaration 800×400 (50–100KB). Free, in your browser.
- [HEIC to JPG Converter — Free, Batch, No Upload](https://pdfslimio.com/heic-to-jpg.html): Convert iPhone HEIC photos to JPG for free: one photo or a whole batch, with a size limit like 1MB or 500KB if a form needs one. Runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded, no signup.

- [HEIC JPG 변환 - 아이폰 사진 무료 변환, 여러 장 한 번에](https://pdfslimio.com/ko/heic-to-jpg.html): 아이폰 HEIC 사진을 JPG로 무료 변환하세요. 여러 장을 한 번에 바꿔 ZIP으로 받고, 1MB·500KB 같은 용량 제한도 맞춰요. 프로그램 설치·회원가입 없이 브라우저 안에서만 처리돼서 사진이 업로드되지 않아요.

- [PDF에 손글씨 서명 넣기 무료: 아이폰·갤럭시·맥·윈도우 기본 기능과 효력까지](https://pdfslimio.com/ko/guides/pdf-sign-free.html): 계약서·동의서 PDF에 손글씨 서명을 넣는 무료 방법을 기기별로 정리했어요. 아이폰 마크업과 미리보기 앱, 맥 미리보기, 갤럭시, 윈도우 엣지, Adobe Acrobat Reader, 설치 없이 브라우저에서 넣는 법과 종이에 쓴 서명을 쓸 때 배경 처리, 전자서명법 기준 효력과 보증처럼 안 되는 서류까지 담았어요.
- [휴대폰으로 서류 스캔해서 PDF 만들기: 아이폰 메모·갤럭시 문서 스캔·구글 드라이브, 용량 제한까지](https://pdfslimio.com/ko/guides/phone-scan-to-pdf.html): 스캐너 없이 휴대폰 기본 기능으로 종이 서류를 PDF로 만드는 방법을 아이폰(메모·파일·미리보기), 갤럭시(카메라 문서 스캔, One UI 8.5 PDF 저장), 구글 드라이브별로 정리했어요. 기기마다 결과가 PDF인지 사진인지가 달라요. 같은 서류 3장을 컬러·회색·흑백으로 만들어 용량을 비교했고, 1MB 같은 제출 제한에 맞추는 법도 담았어요.
- [청소년증 사진 규격 3.5×4.5cm (2024년부터): 발급 방법·기간·재발급 정리](https://pdfslimio.com/ko/guides/youth-id-photo.html): 청소년증 사진은 2024년 1월 1일부터 3×4cm가 아니라 3.5×4.5cm(모자 벗은 상반신, 배경 그림 없이, 6개월 이내)예요. 만 9~18세 대상, 주민센터 방문 신청, 발급 무료, 처리 14일, 임시 청소년증 30일, 복지로 온라인 재발급과 사진 변경 방법을 법령 서식과 정부 안내 기준으로 정리했어요.
- [스캔 PDF 하나를 50KB·100KB·200KB·300KB·500KB·1MB·2MB로 줄여 봤어요: 용량마다 이렇게 달라요](https://pdfslimio.com/ko/guides/pdf-size-test.html): 휴대폰으로 스캔한 3쪽 PDF(3.61MB) 하나를 같은 도구로 일곱 가지 용량에 맞춰 봤어요. 50KB, 100KB, 200KB, 300KB, 500KB, 1MB, 2MB에서 결과 용량과 쪽이 어떻게 바뀌었는지, 글씨가 얼마나 읽히는지 정리했어요.
